# nSelf CLI

> Self-hosted backend platform. One Go binary orchestrates Postgres, Hasura,
> auth and nginx; everything beyond the core is a plugin.

Generated from the cobra command tree — do not hand edit.
Regenerate with `make wiki-commands`.

The golden path is three commands:

```bash
nself init    # write .env
nself build   # generate docker-compose + nginx
nself start   # boot the stack
```

## Commands (25)

### nself add

Install a plugin or bundle

```
nself add <name> [name...] [flags]
```

Flags:

- `--allow-eol` (default false) — Allow installing an EOL plugin (not recommended)
- `--channel` (default stable) — Release channel: stable | beta | canary
- `--checksum` (default "") — Expected SHA-256 checksum of the downloaded archive (third-party URL installs only)
- `--dry-run` (default false) — Show what would be installed without making changes
- `--force` (default false) — Reinstall even when the plugin is already present
- `--key` (default "") — License key for Licensed plugins
- `--preview` (default false) — Preview the dependency tree without installing
- `--show-graph` (default false) — Show dependency graph with topological sort order
- `--skip-sbom-check` (default false) — Skip SBOM verification (air-gapped installs only — sets NSELF_SKIP_SBOM_CHECK=1)
- `--strict` (default false) — Fail if any plugin in the bundle is missing from the registry
- `--tier` (default "") — Force "free" or "licensed" for a slug served as both (e.g. cron, notify); default resolves by license entitlement
- `--version` (default "") — Install a specific version
- `--with-optional` (default false) — Include optional dependencies in --preview output
- `--yes` (default false) — Skip confirmation prompts (required for third-party URL installs in CI)

Full page: [[cmd-add]]

### nself backup

Backup operations: create, list, restore, verify, prune, config, status, init-key

```
nself backup <subcommand> [flags]
```

Subcommands:

- `config` — View backup configuration
- `create` — Create a new backup
- `drill` — Run a DR drill: restore latest backup into scratch DB and measure RTO
- `init-key` — Generate age encryption keypair for backups
- `list` — List available backups
- `pitr` — Point-in-time recovery: enable, disable, status, base-backup, restore
- `prune` — Remove old backups by retention policy
- `restore` — Restore from a backup
- `restore-remote` — Restore a backup directly from a remote URL
- `resume` — Resume an interrupted streaming backup
- `schedule` — Schedule recurring streaming backups via systemd timers
- `status` — Show backup subsystem status
- `stream` — Stream an encrypted backup directly to a remote destination
- `verify` — Verify backup integrity

Full page: [[cmd-backup]]

### nself build

Compose your infrastructure from .env

```
nself build [flags]
```

Flags:

- `--allow-insecure` (default false) — Allow insecure config (dev only)
- `--allow-legacy` (default false) — Bypass v0.9 artifact check and proceed with WARNING (not recommended)
- `--check` (default false) — Validate only, don't build
- `--debug` (default false) — Enable debug mode
- `--diff` (default false) — Print unified diffs of the planned changes to stderr (env files show key names only)
- `--force` (default false) — Force rebuild all components and overwrite hand-edited generated files
- `--hosts` (default false) — Opt in to /etc/hosts management for a BASE_DOMAIN that isn't a recognized local-dev domain (localhost/*.local.nself.org/*.localhost/*.local). Never overrides ENV=prod, which always skips /etc/hosts.
- `--no-auto-redis` (default false) — Disable automatic Redis enablement when a BullMQ-backed plugin is detected
- `--no-cache` (default false) — Disable build cache
- `--no-migration-check` (default false) — Skip v1 artifact detection (for automation/CI)
- `--no-monorepo` (default false) — Disable automatic monorepo backend detection
- `--plan` (default false) — Show what build would change (files, host effects, containers) and write nothing
- `--plan-id` (default "") — Apply only if the change still matches this plan_id (from nself build --plan --json)
- `--profile` (default "") — Service profile: curated subset of services to include in docker-compose.yml.
  app (default) — full service set, identical to pre-profile behaviour.
  ops           — observability + CI server: postgres, hasura, auth, nginx,
                  monitoring stack; excludes minio, mailpit, admin, functions, search.
Overrides NSELF_PROFILE env var. Valid values: app, ops.
- `--quiet` (default false) — Suppress non-error output (for CI use)
- `--remove-orphans` (default false) — Remove containers with no matching service in the freshly generated compose (G-014). Detection always runs; removal is opt-in.
- `--security-report` (default false) — Generate security analysis
- `--verbose` (default false) — Show environment cascade
- `--yes` (default false) — Confirm a change on a prod-class env (prod, staging) without a prompt

Full page: [[cmd-build]]

### nself ci

Run the nself-ci gate suite and post a GitHub commit status

```
nself ci [repo-root] <subcommand> [flags]
```

Subcommands:

- `build` — Build a signed release artifact locally (Android only)
- `eval` — Run eval-gate suite or validate an eval-set YAML
- `forgejo` — Show Forgejo server + runner health (ops profile)
- `serve` — Start the nself-ci webhook listener daemon (port 3845)

Flags:

- `--check` (default false) — Run gates only; do not post a GitHub commit status
- `--filesystem` (default false) — Force gitleaks filesystem scan (--no-git) even inside a git checkout; opt-in for non-checkout source trees such as an exported tarball
- `--no-gitleaks` (default false) — Skip the gitleaks secret scan
- `--no-status` (default false) — Alias for --check
- `--owner` (default "") — GitHub owner (default: from git remote)
- `--repo` (default "") — GitHub repo name (default: from git remote)
- `--sha` (default "") — Commit SHA to report on (default: HEAD)
- `--verbose` (default false) — Print each gate command before running

Full page: [[cmd-ci]]

### nself clean

Remove generated artifacts (docker-compose.yml, nginx configs, build cache)

```
nself clean [flags]
```

Flags:

- `--all` (default false) — Also run a host-wide 'docker system prune' affecting every Docker project on this machine (destructive; requires confirmation)
- `--yes` (default false) — Skip the --all confirmation prompt (for CI/CD)

- `secrets` — Manage encrypted project secrets (age encryption)
- `services` — Manage optional services

- `telemetry` — Manage CLI telemetry preferences
- `trust` — Set up local dev trust (DNS, SSL, port forwarding)
- `validate` — Validate configuration against all registered rules

Flags:

- `--env` (default "") — Target environment (reads .env.{env})
- `--json` (default false) — JSON output
- `--reveal` (default false) — Show secret values in plaintext

### nself db

Database operations: migrations, backups, restore, seed, shell

```
nself db <subcommand> [flags]
```

Subcommands:

- `backup` — Create pg_dump backup
- `backup-sync` — Sync local backups to remote storage (cross-region)
- `backup-sync-status` — Show cross-region backup sync status
- `drift` — Schema drift detection: scan np_* tables for Theme 25 column compliance
- `drop` — Drop the project database (DESTRUCTIVE)
- `fk-index` — Audit and create indexes for foreign key columns
- `generate` — Generate type-safe client SDK types from the live Hasura schema
- `hasura` — Hasura metadata operations
- `import` — Import data from another platform
- `lint` — Check RLS policies on tenant-scoped tables
- `list` — List databases in the project Postgres instance
- `migrate` — Manage database migrations
- `pgbouncer` — PgBouncer connection pooler operations
- `pitr` — Point-in-time recovery: status, enable, test, restore
- `reconcile` — Push repo-declared Hasura metadata (permissions, relationships, table tracking) to a live instance
- `reset` — Drop and recreate database (DESTRUCTIVE)
- `reset-checksum` — Reset stored checksum for a migration (dangerous)
- `restore` — Restore from backup
- `restore-drill` — Run a non-destructive restore drill
- `restore-drill-list` — List past restore drill results
- `rls` — Row-Level Security management: audit, apply, rollback
- `seed` — Database seeding: run, list, verify, graph
- `shell` — Open psql interactive shell
- `soft-delete` — Manage soft-delete (deleted_at) patterns across tables
- `verify` — Verify what a Hasura role can actually reach via role-scoped introspection
- `verify-checksums` — Verify migration file checksums against stored values

Full page: [[cmd-db]]

### nself deploy

Deploy the stack to a target environment

```
nself deploy [target] <subcommand> [flags]
```

Subcommands:

- `access` — Manage SSH key access on an already-deployed server
- `check-access` — Verify access to configured deploy targets (deprecated: use 'nself env target probe')
- `environments` — List configured deploy environments and server capabilities
- `health` — Run health checks against a target deployment
- `logs` — Show deployment logs for a target
- `ops` — Deploy with the ops profile to the ops server
- `promote` — Promote a canary deploy to 100% green traffic
- `promote-env` — Promote one environment to another (e.g. staging to prod)
- `rollback` — Roll back the last deployment for a target
- `security` — Apply server security
- `status` — Show deployment status for a target
- `targets` — List deploy targets without connecting to them
- `web` — Build web apps locally and deploy prebuilt output to Vercel

Flags:

- `--canary` (default 0) — Start a canary deploy at N%% traffic to green (0 = full flip)
- `--dry-run` (default false) — Preview the deploy without executing
- `--env` (default "") — Target environment: local, or any inventory environment such as staging, prod or qa (overrides positional arg; required env vars: NSELF_DEPLOY_HOST, NSELF_DEPLOY_USER, NSELF_DEPLOY_KEY_PATH)
- `--exclude-frontends` (default false) — Exclude frontend apps from the deploy
- `--follow` (default false) — Stream container logs after deploy until Ctrl-C (staging/prod only)
- `--force` (default false) — Skip confirmation prompts (prod requires --confirm or --force)
- `--force-migration` (default false) — Force deploy even with backward-incompatible migrations (disables canary)
- `--include-frontends` (default false) — Include frontend apps in the deploy
- `--json` (default false) — Emit JSON output
- `--rolling` (default false) — Alias for --strategy=rolling
- `--server` (default "") — Deploy to a specific server only (name from control-plane inventory)
- `--skip-canary` (default false) — Skip canary phase and flip directly to 100% green
- `--skip-health` (default false) — Skip post-deploy health checks
- `--strategy` (default rolling) — Deploy strategy: rolling|blue-green|canary|preview
- `--yes` (default false) — Skip prod confirmation prompt (alias for --force)

Full page: [[cmd-deploy]]

### nself doctor

Run comprehensive system diagnostics

```
nself doctor <subcommand> [flags]
```

Subcommands:

- `heal` — Run targeted self-healing routines for nSelf components
- `security` — Diagnose server security

Flags:

- `--ai` (default false) — Run the AI first-run wizard (install Ollama, setup Gemini pool, verify)
- `--alerts` (default false) — Check monitoring alert rules are loaded
- `--check-legacy` (default false) — Scan host for v0.9 stale paths (global scan, not per-project)
- `--deep` (default false) — Alias for --full (run all checks)
- `--fix` (default false) — Auto-fix safe issues
- `--format` (default "") — Output format: json, text (default text)
- `--full` (default false) — Run all checks including network and memory (slower)
- `--headless` (default false) — Print OAuth URL instead of opening browser (for SSH/headless servers)
- `--install-check` (default false) — Run 6-stage onboarding funnel check (used by Homebrew post-install hook)
- `--json` (default false) — JSON output
- `--only` (default "") — Run only a specific subsystem check (host, docker, postgres, hasura, nginx, ssl, ping, plugins, license, monitoring, backups, security)
- `--quick` (default false) — Fast check: infrastructure, disk, ports, config, plugins, license, container health only (the default check set; explicit opt-in overrides --full/--deep)
- `--section` (default "") — Run only a specific section (system, core, backups, license, plugins, monitoring, security)
- `--skip` (default []) — Skip specific check sections
- `--skip-ollama` (default false) — Skip local Ollama installation step
- `--skip-pool` (default false) — Skip Gemini pool setup step
- `--verbose` (default false) — Detailed diagnostics
- `--yes` (default false) — Non-interactive mode: accept all defaults (for CI/scripts)

Full page: [[cmd-doctor]]

### nself init

Initialize a new nSelf project

```
nself init <subcommand> [flags]
```

Subcommands:

- `template` — Browse and publish full-stack app templates

Flags:

- `--cs-template` (default "") — Scaffold a custom service at init time: specify language (go, node, python, rust, other)
- `--demo` (default false) — Auto-configure with all services enabled
- `--domain` (default "") — Base domain (default: local.nself.org; init never prompts for it, e.g. myapp.dev)
- `--dry-run` (default false) — Print files that would be written without writing them (clone templates only)
- `--fast` (default false) — Skip advanced options, use smart defaults
- `--force` (default false) — Overwrite existing configuration
- `--full` (default false) — Create all environment files (.env.dev, .env.staging, .env.prod, .env.secrets)
- `--interactive` (default false) — Explicitly enable interactive wizard
- `--list-presets` (default false) — List all available project presets and exit
- `--name` (default "") — Project name (sets PROJECT_NAME in generated .env)
- `--no-pgvector` (default false) — Skip pgvector extension and RAG scaffold tables (sets PGVECTOR_ENABLED=false)
- `--no-seed` (default false) — Skip seed data when scaffolding a clone template
- `--non-interactive` (default false) — Use all defaults without prompts
- `--preset` (default "") — Use a project-type preset: b2b-saas, mobile-backend, ai-assistant, community-forum, media-hosting, dev, sentry, nclaw-app
- `--profile` (default "") — Resource profile: 'tiny' for small VPS (Postgres+nginx only)
- `--quiet` (default false) — Suppress output messages
- `--skip-validation` (default false) — Skip configuration validation
- `--template` (default "") — Use a built-in, clone, or marketplace template (e.g. airbnb-clone, go, rust)
- `--wizard` (default false) — Run the full 10-step interactive wizard

Full page: [[cmd-init]]

### nself license

Manage license keys for nSelf product bundles

```
nself license <subcommand> [flags]
```

Subcommands:

- `account` — Manage your nSelf account, sessions, licenses, team, and devices
- `add` — Add one or more license keys
- `clear` — Remove all saved license keys
- `export` — Export signed license cache for air-gap transfer
- `health` — Validate format, ping server, and report cache integrity
- `import` — Import a previously exported license cache file
- `list` — Show all configured licenses (alias for status)
- `login` — Log in to your nSelf account
- `logout` — Log out of your nSelf account
- `migrate` — Migrate legacy license key to a nSelf account
- `refresh` — Force-refresh license validation against ping.nself.org
- `remove` — Remove a license key by value or product name
- `restore` — Reactivate dormant plugins with a new license key
- `revalidate` — Force a fresh validation against ping.nself.org and update the cache
- `revoke` — Mark local license as revoked and wipe the stored key
- `set` — Replace all keys with a single key
- `show` — Display license tier, bundles, plugins, and cache expiry
- `simulate-offline` — Simulate being offline for N days (testing only)
- `status` — Show all configured licenses and plugin coverage
- `tail` — Stream live license validation events from ping_api
- `upgrade` — Open pricing page in browser
- `validate` — Validate key against ping.nself.org

Full page: [[cmd-license]]

### nself logs

View and filter service logs

```
nself logs [SERVICE] [flags]
```

Flags:

- `--all` (default false) — Show last 100 lines
- `--compact` (default false) — Compact output: [service] message
- `--errors` (default false) — Show only errors
- `--follow` (default false) — Follow log output (live)
- `--grep` (default "") — Regex pattern filter
- `--json` (default false) — Structured JSON output per line
- `--level` (default "") — Filter by level (error, warn)
- `--more` (default false) — Show last 50 lines
- `--no-color` (default false) — Disable colored output
- `--plain` (default false) — Plain output (no highlighting, for piping)
- `--quiet` (default false) — Filter out noise (healthchecks)
- `--search` (default "") — Search pattern (regex)
- `--service` (default []) — Filter by service name (repeatable)
- `--since` (default "") — Show logs since (e.g. 1h, 30m, or RFC3339)
- `--status` (default false) — Show service status overview
- `--summary` (default false) — Show recent errors by service
- `--tail` (default 10) — Number of lines to show
- `--top` (default false) — Show most active services
- `--until` (default "") — Show logs until (e.g. 1h or RFC3339)

Full page: [[cmd-logs]]

- `--yes` (default false) — Skip confirmation prompt (for CI/CD)

### nself start

Boot your nSelf stack

```
nself start <subcommand> [flags]
```

Subcommands:

- `dev` — Start development environment

Flags:

- `--allow-legacy` (default false) — Bypass v0.9 artifact check and proceed with WARNING (not recommended)
- `--clean-start` (default false) — Remove all containers before starting
- `--debug` (default false) — Show debug information
- `--embedded-pg` (default false) — Boot PostgreSQL via embedded pglite/wasmtime — no Docker postgres container required; pgvector included
- `--force-recreate` (default false) — Alias for --fresh
- `--fresh` (default false) — Force recreate all containers
- `--profile` (default "") — Service profile passed to an automatic rebuild when the compose file is stale.
  app (default) — full service set.
  ops           — observability + CI server (postgres, hasura, auth, nginx, monitoring).
Overrides NSELF_PROFILE env var. Has no effect when --skip-build is set.
- `--quick` (default false) — Quick start (timeout=30, required=60%)
- `--quiet` (default false) — Suppress progress output (for CI; preserves --json output)
- `--skip-build` (default false) — Skip automatic rebuild detection
- `--skip-db-init` (default false) — Skip database migrations and seed; bring up Postgres+Hasura+hasura-auth only. Intended for CI/E2E environments.
- `--skip-health-checks` (default false) — Skip health validation after startup
- `--skip-plugins` (default false) — Start base stack only, skip all plugin compose files
- `--skip-port-check` (default false) — Skip port availability check
- `--timeout` (default 120) — Health check timeout in seconds (range: 30-600)
- `--verbose` (default false) — Show detailed Docker output
- `--watch` (default false) — Enable health auto-restart: poll services and restart unhealthy containers

Full page: [[cmd-start]]

### nself update

Update the nSelf CLI and admin UI

```
nself update <subcommand> [flags]
```

Subcommands:

- `images` — Refresh Docker image digests from registries
- `project` — Upgrade a project's layout from an older nself
- `upgrade` — Upgrade the nSelf CLI (detects install method)
- `verify-sbom` — Verify the SBOM signature for a CLI release

Flags:

- `--admin` (default false) — Only update the admin UI
- `--check` (default false) — Check for updates without installing
- `--cli` (default false) — Only update the CLI binary
- `--force` (default false) — Force update even if already up to date
- `--restart` (default false) — Restart services after update
- `--version` (default "") — Download a specific version (e.g. v1.2.3)

Full page: [[cmd-update]]
